localAgencies.notes: TCEQ issues air permits statewide; check this TCEQ page for local programs that also have requirements.

overview: TCEQ authorizes new and modified air emission sources through a tiered system under New Source Review (NSR): de minimis, permits by rule (PBR), standard permits, and case-by-case NSR permits, with federal PSD and nonattainment review for major sources. Major sites also need a federal operating permit (Title V), issued as a site operating permit (SOP) or general operating permit (GOP).

permitTypes.name: De minimis facilities
permitTypes.description: Facilities or sources meeting the de minimis criteria do not have to obtain any registration or authorization prior to construction.

permitTypes.name: Permits by Rule (PBR)
permitTypes.description: Authorizes facilities that will not make a significant contribution of air contaminants when built and operated under the conditions of a specific PBR. Facilities must meet the general emission limits in 30 TAC 106.4 and other Chapter 106 requirements, such as recordkeeping in 30 TAC 106.8.
permitTypes.quote: An operation may qualify for a permit by rule (PBR) authorization if it emits less than: 250 tons per year (tpy) of carbon monoxide or nitrogen oxides; 25 tpy of volatile organic compounds, sulfur dioxide, or inhalable particulate matter; 15 tpy of particulate matter with diameters of 10 microns or less; 10 tpy of particulate matter with diameters of 2.5 microns or less; 25 tpy of any other air contaminant (exclusions apply). (TCEQ RG-616, rev. January 2026)

permitTypes.name: Standard Permits
permitTypes.description: Permits for specific, well-characterized classes of facilities, authorized under 30 TAC Chapter 116, Subchapter F.

permitTypes.name: Case-by-case NSR permit
permitTypes.description: For facilities that cannot qualify for a PBR or standard permit. Includes amendments, alterations, renewals, and Readily Available Permits (a streamlined option for certain facility types).

permitTypes.name: Flexible permits
permitTypes.description: Lets operators manage operations under an overall emissions cap or individual emission limits; follows the same permitting requirements as NSR permits.

permitTypes.name: Prevention of Significant Deterioration (PSD)
permitTypes.description: Required for a new major stationary source or major modification in an attainment area. TCEQ also administers greenhouse gas PSD permitting.
permitTypes.citation: 30 TAC Chapter 116; GHG thresholds at 30 TAC 116.164(a)

permitTypes.name: Nonattainment review
permitTypes.description: Required when emissions exceed the applicable major source or significance threshold for the nonattainment area and pollutant.

permitTypes.name: Federal Operating Permits (Title V): SOP and GOP
permitTypes.description: Major sites need a federal operating permit. A Site Operating Permit (SOP) is customized to the emission sources at an individual site; a General Operating Permit (GOP) has uniform conditions for all sites in a defined class.
permitTypes.citation: 30 TAC Chapter 122; major source definition at 30 TAC 122.10(13)

oilAndGas.summary: Oil and gas sites follow the same tiered path: de minimis, then PBR (Subchapter O), then the Air Quality Standard Permit for Oil and Gas Facilities, then a case-by-case NSR permit. Major sites may use Title V general operating permits GOP 511 or 514.
